title: ErrorEnvelope
description: Uniform error shape. No internal detail (stack traces, exception text, file paths, credentials) may ever appear in message or details (architecture.md §13.4). error_code is an open, extensible SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE vocabulary, not a closed enum, matching the source proposal's illustrative '...'. schema_version 1.1.0 (Checkpoint C.0.1, docs/adr/0003-phase2-checkpoint-c0-serving-contract.md §4) additively introduces optional structured 'details' -- machine-readable error context (e.g. which room types are supported) must live in typed detail fields, never only inside the human-readable message string. Every existing 1.0.0 instance (no details) remains valid unchanged.

details.description: Flat, bounded, machine-readable context only -- no nested objects, no arbitrary depth, no stack traces/exception text/local paths/credentials/row data. Every value is a short string, number, boolean, or a short list of short strings.
